paraphrase: Formal fact: none of the eight act/potency premises shared by the root routes (non-simultaneity, actuality only insofar as being, act simply prior to potency, goodness is actuality with having a perfection read as being in act in it, moves only as in act, reduced only by a mover, moved only as in potency, second movers move only as moved) follows from the other seven, even together with sensible motion and the well-foundedness of the per se series.
